description: Qualification pass over AI-1's 13 prospects (Found positions 170-182). Fills the empty Fit score column, records the TestGorilla pause, and claims Q-20260911-DARIO for the package lane AI-1 left open. Found positions column Y (Actions) is deliberately untouched, and AI-1's Priority values are left as set except for TestGorilla, where the recorded priority is now factually wrong.

ops.why: Employer-direct URL, worldwide remote on EMEA hours, Independent Contractor engagement that matches the Adaxa B2B model exactly, and the role is core technical paid advertising. No geo, language or engagement caveat.

Employer-direct Breezy URL. Senior strategist role at a B2B SaaS paid-media agency, which is the closest match to the work Dario actually does daily. 4h overlap with 9am-5pm EST is roughly 15:00-20:00 CEST, workable from Croatia.

Employer-direct Teamtailor URL and an exact title match. AI-1 flagged '$500k budget evidence' as conditional, but this is a strength rather than a risk: the verified case-study record is ~EUR 2.5M/month personally managed. Only caveat is US business-hour overlap.

Title is a bullseye and Europe is accepted with 3h US Eastern overlap, but the employer-original posting was not found. Per the rules an aggregator is a discovery source only, so this cannot be packaged until the employer-direct route is confirmed.

Employer-direct CATS URL and a senior performance title, but US business hours are required and the scope is 20-25h per week. Useful as a part-time income bridge during the LHG wind-down rather than as a replacement role. Same employer as the RevOps role at row 62, which also carried a timezone caveat.

Strong day rate (GBP 500-650 for ~3 days/week) and European overlap, but two real frictions: the scope is 0-to-1 GTM leadership rather than paid-media ownership, which is the weakest area in the case-study record, and AI-1 recorded the engagement as individual-only, which conflicts with contracting through Adaxa Agency.

Salary is disclosed (GBP 60-65k) and UK/EU core hours suit Croatia, but 'Accounts Lead' is client account management rather than hands-on paid-media ownership, and the Workable board was not parsed so the employer-direct route is unconfirmed.

Media buying is core, but the employer-original posting was not found and the category is crypto education, which carries Google Ads restriction and reputational considerations. A judgement call for Dario, not an automatic add.

The role appears on the official careers list but the vacancy detail link failed, so scope and seniority are unknown. 'Marketing Specialist' is also broader and likely more junior than the target band.

Interesting domain adjacency (click-fraud protection sits next to Google Ads), but Croatia eligibility is unconfirmed, which is a hard check, and the role centres on pipeline and HubSpot lifecycle work, the weakest evidenced area.
Croatia eligibility unconfirmed, the remit mixes SEO with paid media, and 'Specialist' sits below the target seniority band.
Head of Content is off-profile. It is also the same employer as row 170, and applying for both would weaken the paid-advertising application. Recommend no package time.
Score taken from the existing package's own assessment (83/100) rather than re-derived, so the number stays evidence-backed.
